clock.daily_target: At each source server date, median total native tick_volume of the previous20 observed trading dates divided by48, rounded up to integer at least1. No current-day total enters that day target. All observed dates remain in denominators.
clock.bucket: Accumulate complete observed M1 rows from the first row of that date; close a bucket when cumulative tick_volume reaches the fixed daily target. Never split a minute. Reset accumulation after each completed bucket. Retain incomplete day-end remainder counts as unused clock material. No overnight bucket or transition.
clock.availability: Bucket observation available at final included M1 time+60. Exact source calendar epochs retained with no timezone conversion or intended external session.
clock.scale: Median high-low range of previous20 completed activity buckets, excluding current, floor0.01. Prefix may span prior days; missing prefix is explicit.
features: (bucket bid close - bucket bid open)/previous20bucket median range
sum(sign(M1 close - previous within-bucket M1 close)*tick_volume)/total tick_volume; first M1 uses its own open as reference
clock.measurement: Tick_volume is quote activity, not traded volume or observed order flow. Signed activity is an internal price/tick proxy.

fit.period: All valid2024 completed buckets;2023 is clock/scale warmup only. Whole observed source dates and unavailable prefixes retained.
fit.standardization: 2024-only feature mean/populationSD, floor1e-6; standardized inputs clipped[-6,6].
fit.model: Three-state diagonal Gaussian HMM, exactly20 Baum-Welch passes, daily independent sequences and fixed uniform start prior. Deterministic initial state memberships from feature1 signed-impact terciles; ties use stable chronological rank. Initial means/group means; initial variances pooled feature variances floored0.05. Initial transition diagonal0.8/off-diagonal0.1.
fit.regularization: Each M-step adds1 to every transition count before row normalization, state occupancy floor1e-12, means bounded[-6,6], diagonal variances floored0.05. No state-count, initialization, pass-count, feature or model search.
fit.onnx: Fresh float32 graph computes Gaussian log emissions and posterior Softmax from dynamic normalized observation[1,3],means[3,3],variances[3,3],prior[1,3]. Uses Sub/Mul/Div/Log/Add/ReduceSum/Softmax. Host owns transition state and deterministic preprocessing; all posterior inferences use ONNX. IR8/opset17.

online.initial: Both roles begin2025 from the same2024 HMM/normalization, uniform daily filter, empty pending update. Online effective sufficient-statistic masses initialize state occupancy1/3, sums=mass*mean, second moments=mass*(variance+mean^2), transition masses=A/3.
online.update: Before each new observed bucket D, consume the previous pending observation only if availability<D. Online filtering-EM step alpha0.005: state occupancy/sums/second moments blend with stored posterior gamma and normalized observation; transitions blend with stored xi when within-day predecessor exists. Recompute means, diagonal variance floor0.05 and row-normalized transition masses with1e-6 pseudocount. No smoothing from future observations, reset/tuning or trade-outcome labels.
online.filter: Daily start prior uniform; otherwise prior=previous filtered posterior times current A. ONNX returns current posterior. Within-day xi(i,j)=previous posterior(i)*A(i,j)*posterior(j)/prior(j), normalized to sum1. Store the current observation/gamma/xi for a strictly later parameter update.
online.forecast: After filtering current completed bucket with current parameters, next-state probabilities=posterior*A. Predicted next-bucket signed impact is their weighted emission mean for feature1, transformed back through frozen training mean/std, times current causal range scale. Online updates are from already observed market data, not future trade labels.

strategy.population: Forecast every valid completed bucket regardless of occupancy/session. New entry opportunities are only server-clock08:00<=D<21:00, one position in the replacement Passive slot. All365selection calendar dates and all original observed trading dates are reported, including zero entries.
strategy.signal: Market buy/sell in the sign of predicted points only when absolute prediction>2*max(0.01,last completed M1 spread*0.01). At native execution require the same hurdle against max(last completed spread,fresh executable spread). No direction or time subgroup selection.
strategy.execution: Own candidate requests original legal market execution at first eligible fresh quote in[D,D+60), never later. Original original-component entry/pending engine is disabled only in this replaced slot. Existing five strategies and ordinary aggregate-risk priority remain; the new engine has its own durable pending decision and cannot share old state.
strategy.hold: Close at the next completed activity-bucket observation, or at floor(D/900)*900+4*900, whichever comes first; this is45..60minutes maximum from opportunity. Original catastrophic initialSL remains. No reversion-threshold exit, stop trailing, hold extension or calendar-conditioned rescue. Process old close before any new opportunity at the same bucket.
strategy.risk: Native fresh original CalculateProtectiveStop uses conservative capital*.04, gross half of that budget, full original reserved position risk, .01 volume and original aggregate/margin gates. No risk credit from model confidence. All required broker contract/rounding/freshness/session rules still apply.

selection.period: 2025 only; both halves. STATIC and ONLINE one indivisible bundle. No candidate2026 numeric data before sole-survivor freeze.
selection.scope: Normal preliminary quote-path selection at fixed0.01 volume and fixed100USD risk budget, not whole V7 account economics or compound-growth proof. selection.execution_approximation: Sequential original M1 bid OHLC/spread proxy. Forecast uses only completed rows; next observed M1 open in[D,D+60) represents possible first quote. Long entry=open+that M1 spread, short entry=open. Future spread is execution cost only and never a feature or selection hurdle. At entry risk gross2USD implies200point loss-side initialSL, tick0.01. After entry, open-gap stop precedes timed/clock exit; then adverse minute extreme can hit SL. Long stop fill=min(open,SL), short=max(open+spread,SL). Time/bucket close uses first observed M1 open at/after deadline. Exact native tick/fee/financing/admission evidence remains conditional.
selection.cost: Quote actual uses executable-side bid/ask approximation. Stress additionally deducts max(entry,exit spread)*.01 and any adverse stop gap*.01. No positive financing credit or invented commission. Fees/financing not represented in this M1 approximation remain explicit; actual native ledgers are mandatory.
